vagas.titulo: Talent Acquisition Specialist: Recruiting and Talent Sourcing
vagas.descricao:
# Talent Acquisition Specialist: Recruiting and Talent Sourcing

## About the Role

What if you could use your talent acquisition expertise to help connect skilled professionals with opportunities in the rapidly evolving AI industry?

We’re looking for **experienced Talent Acquisition professionals and recruiters** to support talent sourcing, candidate engagement, and recruitment operations at Alignerr, powered by Labelbox.

You’ll help identify qualified professionals, develop effective sourcing strategies, engage potential candidates, and support recruitment initiatives across a range of specialized projects. Your experience will help us connect the right talent with the right opportunities while improving the efficiency and effectiveness of our recruiting processes.

This is a **fully remote, freelance contract opportunity** for professionals who enjoy working independently, building relationships with candidates, and contributing to talent acquisition initiatives in a fast paced AI environment.

### Position Details

**Organization:** Alignerr, powered by Labelbox

**Type:** Hourly Contract

**Location:** Fully Remote

**Commitment:** Freelance engagement

**Compensation:** $15 to $25 USD per hour

## What You’ll Do

### Source and Identify Qualified Talent

Research and identify potential candidates using LinkedIn, professional networks, internal talent databases, and other sourcing channels. Develop targeted searches to find professionals whose skills and experience align with project requirements.

### Engage Candidates

Conduct personalized outreach to prospective candidates, communicate relevant opportunities, and build relationships with professionals across different industries and areas of expertise.

### Evaluate Candidate Profiles

Review professional backgrounds, skills, experience, and qualifications to assess alignment with project requirements. Identify promising candidates and help prioritize profiles for further consideration.

### Support Recruitment Initiatives

Manage sourcing activities across multiple projects, maintain candidate trackers, monitor outreach results, and follow up with candidates to support recruitment goals.

### Collaborate With Internal Teams

Work with project stakeholders and internal teams to understand talent requirements, refine sourcing strategies, and identify opportunities to improve recruitment outcomes.

### Improve Recruiting Processes

Identify opportunities to optimize sourcing workflows, candidate engagement, and recruitment operations. Contribute ideas that help make talent acquisition processes more effective and scalable.

## Who You Are

* An experienced **Talent Acquisition Specialist, Recruiter, or Talent Sourcer** with a strong understanding of recruitment and candidate sourcing.
* Skilled in identifying and engaging qualified professionals through proactive sourcing strategies.
* Experienced in reviewing candidate profiles and evaluating professional qualifications against specific requirements.
* Comfortable using **LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search techniques, and other talent sourcing tools**.
* Able to manage multiple sourcing activities, maintain organized candidate records, and follow up consistently.
* An effective communicator who can build professional relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment and adapting to changing recruitment priorities.
* Interested in supporting talent acquisition initiatives within the technology and AI ecosystem.

## Relevant Expertise

Experience in one or more of the following areas is particularly valuable.

### Talent Acquisition and Recruiting

Full cycle recruiting, recruitment coordination, candidate screening, talent acquisition strategy, and candidate relationship management.

### Talent Sourcing

Outbound sourcing, talent mapping, LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, professional networking, and targeted candidate outreach.

### Technical Recruiting

Recruiting software engineers, data professionals, AI specialists, machine learning engineers, or other technical and specialized professionals.

### Recruitment Operations

Candidate tracking, recruitment workflows, stakeholder coordination, process improvement, and recruitment reporting.

### Talent Engagement and Growth

Candidate engagement, recruitment campaigns, talent community development, user acquisition, and contributor activation.

### Recruiting Technology and Automation

Applicant tracking systems, recruitment analytics, workflow automation, and AI powered recruiting tools.

## What You’ll Work On

You’ll support recruitment initiatives designed to identify and engage qualified professionals for opportunities across Alignerr.

### Candidate Sourcing

Identify professionals whose backgrounds and skills match specific project requirements, using targeted searches and relevant sourcing channels.

### Candidate Outreach

Create and execute outreach initiatives to introduce opportunities to prospective candidates, encourage engagement, and build talent pipelines.

### Candidate Evaluation

Review candidate profiles, assess relevant experience, and identify individuals who meet the requirements of different projects.

### Recruitment Coordination

Maintain accurate sourcing records, monitor candidate responses, and coordinate with internal teams to support recruitment activities.

### Process Improvement

Help identify opportunities to improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate engagement, and recruitment workflows.

## Good to Know

* This is a **fully remote, hourly freelance contract opportunity**.
* Compensation ranges from **$15 to $25 USD per hour**, depending on the role requirements and relevant experience.
* The work focuses on talent sourcing, candidate engagement, recruitment support, and talent acquisition operations.
* Strong sourcing skills, effective communication, and the ability to evaluate professional profiles are important for success in this role.
* Experience recruiting for technology, AI, or other specialized professional roles is valuable.

## Why You’ll Love This

### Work at the Intersection of Talent and AI

Support talent acquisition initiatives for an organization working within the AI ecosystem.

### Apply Your Recruiting Expertise

Use your sourcing, outreach, and candidate evaluation skills to connect qualified professionals with relevant opportunities.

### Enjoy Remote Flexibility

Work remotely and manage your recruiting activities in a flexible freelance environment.

### Earn Competitive Compensation

Earn between $15 and $25 USD per hour for your recruiting expertise.

### Make an Impact

Help build qualified talent pipelines and support recruitment initiatives that contribute to the development of AI.

Mercor is hiring board-certified radiologists (MDs and DOs) to evaluate health AI models in partnership with a leading AI lab.

You will read de-identified patient charts and judge AI answers to clinical questions in radiology.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Evaluate AI answers to radiology questions for clinical accuracy, safety and alignment with current standards of care
- Check each answer against the patient chart and decide which of two responses is stronger
- Write structured rationales on clinical rigor, completeness and clarity
- Flag errors that could compromise patient safety

**Required Qualifications**

- **MD or DO** from an accredited medical school
- Board certified in **ABR Diagnostic Radiology** through an ABMS member board or the AOA
- Active, unrestricted US medical license
- Residency complete, plus fellowship where your specialty requires one
- **Currently practicing** and seeing patients in the US, with at least 1 year of independent practice after training
- 3+ years of post-training experience strongly preferred
- Clear written communication and close attention to detail

**Project Details**

- Remote and hourly, with flexible part-time hours
- Start date: immediate

**Application & Onboarding**

- Upload your resume
- Complete a 25-minute conversational interview on your background, experience and motivations
- Credential verification: license status, board certification, training and current practice setting
- Receive next steps and onboarding details within a few days

Apply today and put your clinical expertise to work shaping the health models clinicians and patients will rely on.

vagas.titulo: MLOps Engineer, LLM Performance (Kernels, Profiling, Serving)
vagas.descricao:
**Join a leading AI lab's cutting-edge GenAI team to be at the core of the AI revolution, where your expertise fuels the development of the most advanced Large Language Models.**

# 1\. Overview

Join a leading AI lab's cutting-edge GenAI team and help build foundational AI models from the ground up. We're seeking MLOps and ML systems engineers with hands-on experience in large language model infrastructure across any of four areas: accelerator kernel programming, performance profiling and trace analysis, debugging accelerated and distributed workloads, and high-throughput inference serving. Experience with JAX, XLA or TPUs is especially valuable. This role involves AI model training and evaluation work, including writing and assessing ML systems tasks and solutions to generate high-quality training data for frontier AI systems.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates worldwide. Depending on where you are based, your engagement will be arranged through Cincinnatus LLC or one of its trusted employer-of-record partners in your country, with the opportunity to be placed at a leading AI lab as part of their extended workforce. **This is a 40-hour full-time engagement, with no conflicts/no other engagements.**

# 2\. Key Responsibilities

- Design challenging tasks across kernels, profiling, debugging and inference serving, including adversarial problems that expose where frontier models fail on accelerator code (for example Pallas kernels on TPU), and write accurate, well-structured solutions to them.
 
- Guide research and engineering teams to close knowledge gaps and improve AI model performance on ML systems, compilers and training infrastructure topics.
 
- Evaluate ML systems tasks and solutions, and provide clear written technical feedback that stands up to expert review.
 
- Develop guidelines and detailed rubrics covering kernel optimization, profiler output interpretation, distributed systems reasoning, and serving throughput and latency trade-offs.
 
- Collaborate with other subject matter experts to keep training data consistent and accurate.

# 3\. Core Qualifications

- 2+ years of hands-on professional experience in ML systems, ML infrastructure, model serving, or accelerator performance engineering. This is a hands-on systems role rather than an applied modelling or data science one.
 
- Practical experience in at least one of the following, with more than one a strong plus: writing or optimizing custom kernels (Pallas, Triton, CUDA, CUTLASS); performance profiling and trace analysis (JAX/XLA profiler, Kineto, torch.profiler, Nsight); debugging distributed or accelerator-bound workloads; serving large language models at scale (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, JetStream, KV cache, paged attention, continuous batching).
 
- Working production experience with JAX and/or PyTorch. Framework-level depth is a strong plus: custom operators, sharding and distributed training (pjit/shard_map, FSDP, Megatron, MaxText), or compiler and graph-level work (XLA/StableHLO, torch.compile, MLIR).
 
- Experience with modern accelerators such as TPU (v4 to v6e), H100, B200, Trainium or MI300, and the ability to reason about throughput, latency and memory trade-offs.
 
- Demonstrable career progression.
 
- Ability to engage reliably for at least 40 hours/week during weekdays.
 
- Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly.

**About Cincinnatus LLC:**
Cincinnatus LLC is an enterprise staffing company that partners with leading technology companies to source and engage highly skilled professionals for contingent and contract-based opportunities. Working directly or through local employer-of-record partners, Cincinnatus handles the employment or contracting relationship, payroll, benefits where applicable, and compliance in each country, while placing professionals directly within client teams to work on high-impact initiatives.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**
Cincinnatus is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or any other legally protected characteristic.

About Turing: 
 Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
 Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

 Role Overview: 
 We are seeking an experienced Physics expert to lead a pod of trainers building realistic, terminal-based scientific tasks for Terminal Bench Science. You will review every task your trainers produce for physical correctness, reproducibility, and grader reliability, and coach trainers to consistently deliver high-quality, challenging tasks.
.
 What you'll do: 
 • Review trainer tasks end to end, including task statements, datasets, simulation inputs, environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
 • Verify that tasks reflect authentic physics workflows and require genuine multi-step reasoning.
 • Check that tools, libraries, and dependencies are pinned and that results are reproducible.
 • Validate dimensional consistency, unit systems and conventions, conservation laws, symmetries, integrator energy drift, convergence, and statistical treatment of uncertainties.
 • Ensure tolerances reflect legitimate stochastic and numerical variation without accepting physically incorrect results.
 • Ensure graders verify observables, fitted parameters, uncertainties, or physical invariants rather than formatting.
 • Ensure tasks cannot be gamed through hard-coded outputs or bypassed computation.
 • Provide clear, actionable written feedback and track revisions through closure.
 • Onboard and mentor trainers.
 • Allocate work, track quality and throughput, and escalate blockers.
 • Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks.
